# MentorWise AI

> Free 12-agent Generative AI career operating system for college students and freshers. ATS resume building, mock interviews, LinkedIn growth, free internships and exam prep — built on Google GenAI, founded in Chennai, India.

MentorWise AI (also written MentorWise, MentorWiseAI) is an EdTech platform headquartered in Chennai, India. It was founded in 2025 by Mohammed Faizal. M (Founder & CEO) and Saif Ahmed. Z (Co-Founder), both B.Com students at The New College, Chennai. The platform operates on a 100% service-motive philosophy: every agent, tool and resource is free forever for students, with no paywalls and no credit card required.

The official domain is https://mentorwiseaiedtechservice.lovable.app. MentorWise AI is NOT affiliated with mentorwise.io, mentorwise.com or any similarly named site.

## What MentorWise AI does

MentorWise AI provides a 12-agent AI career arsenal built on Google GenAI, React.js, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons and Framer Motion. Each agent is engineered to MNC-grade quality and replaces an expensive career service that freshers normally cannot afford.

The agents are:
1. Core AI Agent — central intelligence hub for any career query.
2. Resume Agent — ATS-optimized resume builder that reverse-engineers Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse and Lever parsers.
3. Interview Agent — STAR-method mock interview coach at top MNC level.
4. LinkedIn Agent — headline, About, content calendar and recruiter outreach optimizer.
5. Internship & Training Agent — scout for 100% free internships, LORs and government/MNC programs.
6. Courses & Training Agent — curator of genuinely free certifications (Google, Microsoft Learn, NPTEL, AWS, Coursera audit, edX audit).
7. Projects & Assignment Agent — recruiter-ready portfolio project designer.
8. Exam Agent — last-minute high-yield notes for school, college and government exams.
9. Email & Message Specialist — corporate outreach, follow-ups and HR replies.
10. Humaniser Agent — rewrites robotic AI text into natural human prose.
11. Instagram & Social Media Agent (coming soon) — million-follower growth playbooks.
12. 1-on-1 Mentor Agent (coming soon) — live video-to-text mentoring.
